selection: Eight lowest SHA-256(seed + source basename) among direct top-level source archives, excluding previously used event/collection families and unidentified event-ID archives; at most one source per family. Up to 64 .slp members per source, smallest SHA-1 of UTF-8 member path. No replacement for unavailable members or SHA-256 duplicates.
deduplication: Exclude SHA-256 matches to all 905 original development inputs, all 512 retired holdout inputs, and within the new selection.
use: New independent final validation only after candidate/profile freeze. No candidate encoding, tuning, or profiling of these files before final validation.
prior_holdout_status: holdout-retirement.json records its failed independent result; those 512 files are now development/validation only.
metrics: Default level 3, one replay per archive, 9 interleaved repetitions after warmup, one and eight independent workers, all samples retained; report throughput, elapsed time, packed sizes, decoding, and monitored power.
limitations: Source-family labels reduce related-game leakage but are heuristic. Exact hashing does not exclude altered recordings of a game. Source archives were previously decoded/recompressed during migration.
